interpretation.renderer: Existing finite-3D production path sampler; bounded complete-route 2.5D prototype not ported.
interpretation.timing: Host-observed warmed state submission + trace + GPU reduction + blocking readback + finite checks. Setup/cold dispatch, Unity startup, audio/DSP excluded. Two frequency rows share one query time.
interpretation.memory: Allocated GPU buffers and accounted CPU numeric buffers; excludes general managed scene data and Unity/driver memory.
interpretation.horizon: Scale-series extent grows at fixed delay horizon; nearby-probe control keeps all source/receiver distances 4–8 m.
interpretation.motion: One crate alternates position between queries; not continuous moving-boundary acoustic accuracy.
interpretation.accuracy: ~720% room complex-pressure error at 125 Hz / 1024 rays. Geometry acceleration preserves the result; not high-fidelity or DLSS-teacher validation.
interpretation.waveReference: Reused order-4 finite-room FEM, 80033 DOFs; two refinements. Observed convergence is not certified error.
interpretation.tests: Passing suites overlap; do not sum as unique coverage. Existing compiler warnings retained in logs.
interpretation.preprocessing: Acoustic mesh/edge simplification proposed in report, not implemented.
